items.title: UFBU announces September action over five-day banking demand
items.summary: UFBU announced escalating strike action beginning 11 September, with five-day banking among its principal demands. This shows that implementation remained pending.

items.title: AIBOC reports nationwide demonstrations demanding five-day banking
items.summary: AIBOC reported UFBU demonstrations held on 12 August seeking immediate implementation of the five-day banking commitment.

items.title: UFBU calls nationwide demonstrations for 12 August
items.summary: AIBEA published the UFBU call for demonstrations demanding implementation of five-day banking.

items.title: UFBU discusses PLI and five-day banking
items.summary: UFBU circular 2026-15 recorded continuing discussions and follow-up. No official implementation notification was reported.
items.source: Federation of Bank of India Staff Unions

items.title: Nationwide bank strike held over five-day week demand
items.summary: Bank employees observed a nationwide strike seeking implementation of a five-day work week, indicating that approval was still pending.

items.title: Government acknowledges IBA proposal on all Saturdays
items.summary: The Finance Ministry told the Lok Sabha that IBA had proposed declaring all Saturdays as banking holidays; the reply did not announce approval or an implementation date.
